en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a small wooden chapel or church set among trees and vegetation. The building has a steep gabled roof, painted wooden siding, and tall narrow arched windows in a simple Gothic style. A low fence runs in front of the chapel, and there is a modest entrance porch. In the lower left corner, handwritten-style text identifies the location.
